method: EODHD close-on-pick-date → latest close · excess vs STW.AU (ASX) / SPY.US (US)
headline: The book roughly coin-flipped on direction and net lagged a simple index buy by ~5 points — we have an edge in one lane (Week holds), not across the board.

learnings.text: Quality large-cap software held into a Week window — WDAY +38%, MSFT +32%, TEAM & PLTR +27%. Multi-day trends, not one-day pops.
ASX uranium re-rating names paid on Week/Long — BOE +29%, PDN +7–10%, ILU +9%.
Every worst call was a US momentum name bought AFTER a big run — ALAB, RKLB, MU lost 22–34% mean-reverting.
Binary post-event plays lost — MRNA (FDA) −19%, SLS −23%. Classic buy-rumour-sell-news.
Day picks are structurally weak here — 40% win, negative expectancy, worst lag. The intraday edge didn't hold.

adjustments: Shift conviction from Day → Week: a marginal catalyst now defaults to Week, and a Day slot needs a stricter catalyst score.
Deepen the LATE penalty (−1.0 → −1.5) and hard-exclude US momentum names >20% above their 20-day average at pick time.
Penalise catalysts already printed & moved >5% today — deny Day status to a catalyst the market has already priced.
Route thin-catalyst ASX small-caps to Week/Long rather than chasing them same-day.
caveat: Thin & concentrated: ~6 weeks, heavy ticker overlap (PLTR picked 6×, EOS 5×). A few names swing the aggregates — treat as suggestive, not proven. 12 fresh 05-Aug calls still open, excluded from the headline.
